title: Set up the clinic's periodontal chart
summary: Probing order, margin sign and maintenance intervals.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart is the guide.

steps.title: Settings
steps.details: The gear on the exam bar. It applies to the whole clinic.

steps.title: What can be set
steps.details: Probing order (by arch or buccal first), margin sign (recession positive or negative: stored the same way) and maintenance months for each risk.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Only those who edit the system settings can save it.
